name: Mandate demo agent
description: Generic sign-up and browsing agent. It acts only under a mandate signed by a verified adult human (Concordium ID, zero-knowledge age proof), signs every HTTP request with its CIS-8-bound key, and pays x402 invoices in CCD from its registered agent wallet. Testnet demo.

skills.name: Sign up
skills.description: Creates an account on a site that accepts Concordium mandates instead of a CAPTCHA.

skills.name: Post a comment
skills.description: Posts a comment on behalf of the mandate issuer.

skills.name: Buy a report
skills.description: Buys a paid resource via x402 in CCD within the mandate's spend caps.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.

extensions.description: Mandate: requests carry a mandate signed by the agent's owner (scope, expiry, spend caps, age proof) and are signed with the agent's CIS-8 key. Verifiers check them against Concordium.

params.anchor: CIS-8004 agent metadata key mandate:<id> = sha256:<JCS hash>|exp:<unix> or revoked|at:<unix>
